nom: belif Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.texte: Smells great, looks great under makeup, offers effective sun protection. It does leave a bit of a cast, and I seem to be sensitive to something in the formula because my face initially goes a bit red right after applying. Havent had issues with clogged pores. Id say this is great if youre wearing it under foundation but if youre primarily looking for a standalone sunscreen theres probably better options.
Nice texture and lack of smell. Excellent quality, to the point that it's a little hard to take off. May cause a white cast on darker skin tones.

I tried this out for a few weeks, compared to other sunscreens I use, I noticed it leaves a white cast on my face no matter how much I rub the product in . Besides that, I absolutely love the smell and texture. I usually where this when I'm home and outside doing yard work or if I have no plans of going out to public places which kind of sucks but I am still getting good use of it! I probably wouldn't purchase this myself.

Belif sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. One thing I like about this sunscreen is that it doesn't leave a white cast on my medium-warm skin tone like many sunscreens on the market. The sunscreen is relatively lightweight and absorbs rather quickly. If you are sensitive to greasy products, this liquid sunscreen is for you, as it doesn't feel sticky and greasy after application. It does have that synthetic sunscreen smell upon application, but the smell fades after a few minutes.

Received in exchange for honest review. Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is a nice lightweight option that doesn't feel heavy or greasy. It blends in better than a lot of mineral sunscreens I've tried no major white cast on my light skin. Wears well under makeup too. I like that it's fragrance-free and non-irritating. Great for everyday use!

I've been using this facial sunscreen for a few weeks now, and overall, I'm impressed. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving that greasy, sticky residue that so many others do. Which is perfect for those of us who wear glasses. I've worn it during long sunny days outdoors, and it's held up beautifully—no sunburn! I love how dewy this makes your skin look as well. It's almost like a moisturizer and sunscreen in one, which I will always take.
This sunscreen doesn't drag on the face and leaves a dewy look!
The product is very easy to use, it doesn't have such a strong smell or a bad smell, its aroma is like citrus, it helps a lot with the sun, its consistency is creamy

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again!
avis.texte: Lightweight, doesn't leave a grey cast and the scent is light as well!
I love this sunscreen. It protects while making my skin look great. I will say that if you have darker skin, it will leave a white cast.

I found I could only use this product on my hands and body because (even with blending) the white cast would not go away. I also did not like the smell. I did love the matte properties of the sunblock!

belif is a popular Korean brand and I've enjoyed few of their skincare products. This new mineral sunscreen is overall fantastic. Love that it has high spf 50 without the horrible white or gray cast. It does have minimal whitening initially but not perceptible after dry down. It has a light lemony scent, no typical sunblock smell. The consistency is not as lightweight or slippery, more like a creamy lotion. It applies evenly but feels a bit thick on skin although it's not greasy or sticky. It has various silicones in the ingredients so it does help to prime skin for makeup. Not overly mattifying but no shine throughout wear. Not drying. No irritations. It's great for dry, mature skins and in winters. Not sure how this fares for oily skins or in summers. A respectable mineral sunscreen.

Thanks Belif for the free dew guard sunscreen! I am happily surprised at how good this is. As someone with dark skin many sunscreens leave a white cast on my face but this one didn't. It was very easy to rub into my skin and it didn't burn my eyes either. Though I couldn't tell if this brightened my skin it was great as a sunscreen.
Hydrating mineral SPF 50 that soothes redness, absorbs invisibly, and doubles as a smooth primer under makeup. Lightweight, non-sticky, no white cast—perfect for sensitive skin.
Dew guard spf 50 has a great amount of spf. Goes on good not greasy but leaves a slight white cast you need to rub in. Other than that another great staple in skin care routine.

avis.titre: Loved the Sun Coverage from this!
avis.texte: Belif kindly sent me the Dew Guard - mineral sunscreen SPF 50 for free to review. I loved this sunscreen, it gave great sun coverage and was a wonderful base under some light makeup. It went on smooth and I felt that it went on very evenly. The only slight downside was a minimal white cast and some fragrance. I have sensitive skin and the fragrance didn't bother me and seemed to disappear quickly. I loved that this also helped with redness on my cheeks!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: After using this Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 about 5-6 times in preparation for both hiking and outdoor volleyball, I would not recommend it to anyone who doesn't like a heavy/greasy feeling sunscreen. It does keep your skin safe from sun damage, but it leaves a greasy feeling even after it's absorbed into the skin. It is not one I like to reapply after one layer. When I had a spray sunscreen with me I opted to spray my face the second or third time I needed to reappy rather than going in again with this sunscreen.

I love using this sunblock. My skin looks dewy, feels very hydrated for a long time and smells good. My worry with sunblocks is it looking and feeling dry on my already dry skin but no! The consistency is perfect and melts into the skin. It smells refreshing with that touch of citrus.

avis.titre: A nice addition to my face routine
avis.texte: I like this product, it feels soft and moisturizing. A little goes a long way and it's not oily. I will be adding this to my morning skin routine
It leaves your skin feeling fresh and Dewey without leaving any residue behind. It was extremely moisturizing for my face.

I received this product free in exchange for a review. I do like this brand, and this product feels very nice and has a pleasant scent. I wore it under makeup and it was moisturizing without causing oiliness. The only thing is it does leave a little bit of a white cast; however, when I put my makeup on, it wasn't noticeable. It might be better for winter on fair/light skin. I would recommend this to anyone who doesn't mind a tiny bit of a white cast. I have developed a sensitivity to niacinamide, which this product contains, so I cannot continue to use it. I did not realize this product had niacinamide before I used it, and I still did not notice any stinging or redness even around my eyes.

I really enjoyed this sunscreen. The formula is neither too heavy nor too watery. It was very easy to blend in without leaving a white cast. I really did notice a difference in redness, and my face looked brighter. Slight citrus scent, not overpowering.

I have been using this sunscreen either alone, or under makeup. Either way, it's a winner! It goes in smooth and makes my skin feel moisturized without feeling greasy. It has a mild, pleasant smell. While I was provided a free sample in exchange for an honest review, I can safely say I would purchase and recommend this sunscreen!

I am an acne prone girly . It is so hard to find spf that dosnt break me out . I love how it melts into the skin . It helps protect it I didn't have to reply it. But my skin looks so dewy and I loved it . It's like a skin protector and skin care I'm obsessed.

avis.titre: Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 Is a Hit!
avis.texte: Tried this recently and it's pretty great overall. It goes on with a bit of a white cast at first, but that fades after a minute or two once it settles in. The texture is light, not greasy, and it gives a nice dewy (not oily) finish. Wore well under makeup, didn't sting my eyes, and no breakouts. SPF 50 is a win, and it feels gentle on the skin. Solid daily sunscreen, especially for a mineral formula.

avis.titre: I  would absolutely buy this product again!!
avis.texte: I don't wear a lot of makeup - nor do I have a huge stash of facial products. Once I find something I like I tend to stick with it until I can't buy it anymore. I have been using EltaMD SPF face lotion for years - but figured it wouldn't hurt to try this face lotion since it has a higher SPF and I was given a free sample. I absolutely LOVE this face lotion. It doesn't smell like sunscreen (which I was afraid of), it's easy to rub in, it leaves my skin looking moisturized (but not greasy), it evens out my skin tone , and it doesn't cost a fortune. My teenage daughter loves it too! Definitely 10/10.
I used this every day for about a week before I went on a walk. It feels hydrating but it does have white cast so if you don't like that or have a darker complexion, it might be an issue.

When I first put it on it was super thick. I was a bit skeptical. It ended up blending in nicely, and didn't make my make look weird. I spent all day outside, I used my normal sunblock on my body and this kind on my face. I didn't get a burn on my face, but my body did.
You better belif that this sunscreen is effective! Sunscreen is not greasy upon application and is great under makeup. After couple of hours, this does not hurt my eyes! Which is a huge yes for me!

avis.titre: Works very well but not a fan of the scent
avis.texte: I receive this product from BzzAgent for free in exchange for my honest review. Overall, I'm mostly impressed with this Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen spf 50. I am pretty pale and I burn very easily. I put this sunscreen on and sat outside for 30 minutes for the last week. Not even a slight burn! Not even on my nose or forehead, which usually would burn the easiest. So it definitely works! However, the scent reminds me of mosquito repellent, and about 30-45 minutes after applying the sunscreen, I start feeling a bit itchy. I don't know if it's from the sun or sunscreen, but it doesn't last long. So, yes. Overall it works great, but the scent could definitely be improved!

avis.titre: I works well for my skin. Love it!
avis.texte: This sunscreen absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. It evens out my skin tone, gives my skin a natural, smoother look, and doesn't leave a white cast after makeup. I apply it after my moisturizer and before my foundation. It's great under makeup. My eyes are very sensitive and get irritated a lot if it gets in my eyes.

One of the first things I noticed about this product when I used it was that it has a scent. I am very sensitive to scents and usually do not use anything scented. But this has a very light citrus smell similar to Vitamin C products I have used in the past. It goes away quickly too. It starts out with a little white cast but quickly rubs in and goes away. This sunscreen lasted me all day (without me sweating or swimming). The only real downside is it was a little greasy feeling that never really went away. I do find that to be common of mineral formulas though. Yes l, would recommend this to someone looking for a good mineral sunscreen.

This is a great moisturizer. It doesn't have the typical sunscreen heaviness (or chalky feel) to it. It worked really well with my skincare and makeup routine (it's a wonderful base). It also felt very nice without makeup. It blends into the skin perfectly, no whitecast to be seen!
This is light weight and leaves no weird cast on my face. I noticed that it helped with my redness but was not a skin tint in any way. Perfect for days when you want no makeup.

Love this sunscreen! I've been using the Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 every morning and I'm seriously impressed. It feels super lightweight, blends in easily with no white cast, and leaves my skin looking fresh and dewy—not greasy. I also love that it has niacinamide and hydrates my skin throughout the day. Perfect under makeup too! Definitely my new go-to sunscreen.

I received this product in exchange for a review and I was so excited because I use a ton of sunscreen! I really loved this product because it was really lightweight on my skin and didn't feel sticky or heavy. Sometimes with other brands, I get a lot of clogged pores, but this one was perfect! I reapplied every 90 minutes and didn't get any breakouts! I will continue to use Dew Guard sunscreen because I loved this one so much!

I really enjoy using this sunscreen since it doesn't take me a million years to rub it into my skin. I think the finish it leaves is super fun and if you're into the dewy look then this would be perfect for you. I didn't notice any irritation or redness. I do wish that the SPF was higher but overall very happy with this sunscreen!

As as sunscreen this gets the job done well. Blends in smoothly, doesn't leave a residue and no white cast. Would have given 5 stars but was not a fan of the scent (personally prefer skincare to be unscented in general).

This sunscreen hits ALL the marks! The sunscreen is a bit on the thicker side, but goes on smoothly and does not feel cakey. It made my skin appear more smooth and less red! I had no evidence of sunburn and it felt like it stayed on well despite sweating. It did not clog my pores, it is not greasy and provided the perfect amount of protection. I did receive this item in exchange for my honest review, and this is now my go-to sunscreen!!!

avis.titre: I'm Very Picky About Sunscreen, and I'm So Glad I Tried This
avis.texte: I've gone through so many sunscreens trying to find the right one for my sensitive skin, and this one from belif really impressed me. It's a mineral sunscreen with SPF 50, which is already a win for me, but what makes it special is how light and comfortable it feels on the skin. It doesn't leave a white cast, which is something I've struggled with in the past, especially with mineral formulas. What I also love is that it sits really well under makeup. No pilling, no greasy finish, just a smooth base. I have sensitive skin that tends to get red when I'm out in the sun too long, and this sunscreen actually helps calm that down. After a few days of using it, I noticed my skin looked more even and less irritated. If you're someone who's sensitive, easily irritated, or just super selective with sunscreen like me—this one is absolutely worth a try.

avis.titre: Perfect facial to wear every day in the summer!
avis.texte: I love the light fresh scent of this sunscreen. It isn't the typical sunscreen scent found with most sun-protecting products. It feels lightweight and is not greasy. It is perfect to wear under makeup and the moisturizing effect is great for my dry skin. So far it seems to have reduced redness, but the full effect will be seen after long term use.
Wore it fishing under my foundation and I will preface by saying I'm super picky about my sunscreen. It didn't feel greasy and blended well. Kept me from burning for 10 hours of fishing!

avis.titre: The 50ml size is convenient to carry, and the packaging is c
avis.texte: The 50ml size is convenient to carry, and the packaging is clean and easy to use. Overall, I highly recommend this sunscreen for anyone looking for a gentle, effective, and skin-friendly sun protection product.

I'm not a fan of this sunscreen. I tried it on my face but now I regret it--it left a pronounced white cast and it feels greasy and tacky to the touch, even 10 minutes after applying it. I'm going to strictly use it on my neck and body from now on because I feel like it could clog pores and cause breakouts on my face. The packaging says that it "visibly brightens dull skin tone" but I don't see any of that happening, unless by "brighten," they mean lighten. My face is definitely several shades lighter than my body, which is not the look I'm going for.

So I tried this facial sunscreen both alone and under makeup as a primer. It works nicely as a primer. Alone it seem to work I didn't feel greasy nor had a white cast on my face. No sunburn during this heatwave.
This sunscreen is easy to spread and also has a pleasant smell. It does not pill under makeup.

I am so impressed with this sunscreen! First off, the packaging is beautiful… clean, modern, and easy to use, which makes reaching for it every morning feel like a treat. The formula itself is a total win. It blends effortlessly into the skin with no white cast, and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. The light, fresh scent is lovely and doesn't linger too long, perfect for daily wear. With SPF 50, I feel confident I'm giving my skin the strong protection it needs from harmful UV rays. I've also noticed my skin looking brighter and less red since I started using it… an unexpected bonus! I'd absolutely recommend Dew Guard to anyone looking for a daily sunscreen that not only protects but also helps to calm and even out your complexion. It's become a skincare staple for me!

avis.titre: Subtle scent, no white cast or pilling when layering
avis.texte: My initial thought is that the 50mL (1.69 oz) packaging size is great for travel. The applicator works well and there is no mess. The product scent is very subtle. The consistency of the product is like a lotion. Although the product color is white, it blended easily and did not leave a white cast on my 49-year old, fair, redness-prone skin. Within 5 minutes, it had absorbed to a dewy finish and I was able to layer primer and foundation without any pilling. I live in the Southwest desert where the sun is strong and this product was effective at preventing sunburn.

The Dew Guard Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is a great sunscreen for everyday use. It feels light on the skin and doesn't leave a greasy or sticky feeling. It blends in nicely without leaving a white cast, which is good for many skin tones. The sunscreen gives strong protection from the sun, so I feel safe wearing it outside. It also doesn't have a strong smell, which I like. Overall, it's easy to apply and keeps my skin feeling soft and protected all day.

The sunscreen is very lightweight & smooth making it easy to blend into the face. It does have a slight scent to it, but not super strong. I am not a huge fan that it has a slight tint to it to reduce facial redness, but I know many people love that. I personally do not like foundations or tint on my face so it threw me off a bit. Besides that, the product works great !

avis.titre: Smells great, good for fair skin.
avis.texte: The smell of this product is delicious. It's not overpowering and doesn't have that strong artificial scent most sunscreens have. As a medium/fair skinned person I do see a whitecast but it does dissapate after a couple of minutes. As it states, it's very hydrating, I used it instead of a moisturizer and my skin is soft and plump. Considering it's a mineral sunscreen people should expect a whitecast, but this one fades which is a huge bonus for me.

avis.titre: I would not repurchase. Purchase the SPF 45!
avis.texte: This product gives white cast on black skin upon application. Though the white cast fades a few minutes after (I think after absorbing into the skin) I dislike it. Because it's not something you can use on-the-go. I prefer the SPF 45 sunscreen belif offers.
First time trying Belif sunscreen. Nice no white cast I need to use a few more times to really see how well it works.
Love how this makes my redness disappear. Plus You need spf plus hydration.
